notes.title: Hotfix Release 2 on June 20
notes.content: Fix potential crash issues that may occur at the end of Chapter 3 on some computers, improving game stability.

notes.title: Hotfix on June 20th
notes.content:
​​1.Fixed a delay bug in the ending cinematic animation of Chapter 1.​​
​​2.Fixed a bug where players could miss collecting the BOSS's loot in Chapter 4, leading to a game block.​
